summary: iter-213 Production-Proof hardening HTTP verification. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter213_http_endpoints.py (22 HTTP tests) covering ALL changed backend endpoints: soak lifecycle hardened (frozen_versions on start; checkpoint carries scope/account_connected/invariants{unknown_rate,unknown_rate_ok,duplicate_executions,duplicates_ok,unconfirmed_ghosts,reconciliation_ok,rejects_24h}/global_health{degraded_mode,critical_failing}/version_drift/green/evidence{seq,hash,prev_hash,release,checkpoint}); GET /api/ops/soak/status includes severity_definitions {critical,major,minor} + coverage_required=1.0 + major_incidents_within_budget criterion; GET /api/ops/soak/evidence returns records+chain_valid=true for admin and 403 for non-admin; account-scoped soak invariants seed 4 trades on campaign account + 2 duplicate-signal_id trades on OTHER account and verify checkpoint counts ONLY the campaign account (trades_24h=4, duplicate_executions=0); /api/certification/strategy?scope=ai carries tier ∈ {CERTIFIED_A/B/PROVISIONAL/UNCERTIFIED} + 5 checks incl. lower_bound_clears with passed==(tier∈A/B); POST /certification/issue strategy → 30d expires_at, system own-account → 7d, system other-user's account → 404 BOLA, bad kind → 400; GET /certification/active tenant isolation (user A cannot see user B's cert) + admin sees all + valid/expired/revoked fields; POST /certification/revoke admin-only (non-admin 403), reflects revoked=true & valid=false in /active, unknown cert_id → 404; /api/ops/broker-validation admin first check is live_environment with value LIVE/DEMO/PAPER — DEMO detected from broker_server 'ICMarkets-Demo02', PAPER from mode=paper, LIVE from explicit broker_environment; /api/brain/health?scope=account includes broker_environment field. Offline P0 gates: pytest -m unit with NO env vars → 1595 passed / 4 skipped / 0 failed (isolation guaranteed); tests/test_iter213_production_hardening.py → 19 passed. Regression spot-check: /api/brain/coverage, /api/brain/value-ledger, /api/latency/clock-skew all 200. TOTAL: 22/22 HTTP + 19/19 offline hardening + 1595/1595 isolated unit = 100%. Cleanup verified: soak_campaigns.RUNNING=0, iter213 users/accounts/trades=0.
critical_code_review_comments: soak_campaign._account_invariants correctly applies {account_id} scope filter to ALL invariant queries (trades_24h, latency-traced, duplicate_executions, unconfirmed_ghosts, rejects_24h) — cross-account duplicate signal_ids on a NON-campaign account are NOT counted, verified end-to-end with seeded data.

soak_campaign._append_evidence builds hash chain with (prev_hash + canonical_json(record_minus_hash)) and verify_chain re-computes and compares; tampering test in offline suite proves detection works. HTTP evidence endpoint returns chain_valid=true after real checkpoints.

certification_routes._owned_account uses parse_object_id + user_id scope for non-admin → both invalid ObjectId and cross-tenant IDs return 404 (anti-enumeration correct). POST /certification/issue{kind:system,account_id:<other user's>} → 404 verified.
certification.issue() distinguishes 7d (system) vs 30d (strategy) expiry — delta_days verified within 0.1 tolerance of both.
certification.active() filters by user_id when admin=false and returns everything when admin=true — tenant leak test proves user A's /active does NOT surface user B's cert_id, and admin can see it.
certification.revoke uses find_one_and_update on {revoked:false} guard → unknown cert_id returns 404 via route wrapper (no state mutation possible on already-revoked).

broker_env.broker_environment resolution order (explicit field > mode=paper > server-name demo tokens > LIVE default) verified across all three modes via /api/ops/broker-validation checks[0]==live_environment. broker_environment key is surfaced at both response top-level AND check.value.
intel_scopes.account_health surfaces broker_environment on /api/brain/health?scope=account — verified for paper mode account.
soak_routes._require_admin returns 403 (not 401) for non-admin on /soak/evidence — matches other soak endpoints (consistent AuthZ policy).

Suggestion (non-blocking): soak_campaign.start returns HTTP 200 with {error:'campaign_already_running'} instead of 409 — this is an intentional idempotent shape (already covered by iter-212 tests) but future consumers may prefer a proper HTTP status. Not a bug.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22/22 iter-213 HTTP + 19/19 offline hardening + 1595/1595 isolated unit)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter213_http_endpoints.py is the canonical HTTP regression for iter-213 P0/P1 hardening. Key gotchas: (1) Only ONE soak campaign can be RUNNING at a time — the TestAccountScopedSoak class pre-cleans RUNNING in Mongo before starting its scoped campaign, and cleans it up in a finally-block; the platform-wide TestSoakLifecycleHardened uses the module-scoped soak_cleanup fixture. (2) On the preview DB, platform-wide checkpoints are legitimately NOT green (unknown_rate 0.95 + legacy duplicate signal_ids) — that's why test_checkpoint_full_shape only asserts shape/typing, not green=true. The account-scoped test uses freshly-seeded trades with latency_trace and unique signal_ids and CAN assert clean invariants. (3) DEMO detection via server name 'ICMarkets-Demo02' — the account has mode='live' otherwise mode=paper wins. (4) admin sees ALL certs via /active (admin=True path in certification.active) — verified in TestCertificationActive.test_admin_sees_all. (5) Non-admin 403 on /certification/revoke is enforced BEFORE the DB lookup (routes/certification_routes.py:70) — no info leak. All 22 tests pass in 6.25s on first run, no flakes observed.
